name: text_to_speech
description: Convert short text to speech using Soniox. Returns an MP3 audio file. Each call accepts at most about 300 characters, about 20 seconds of audio; use text_to_speech_long for longer text. Set language to the language the text is written in. Speed ranges from 0.7 to 1.3, where 1.0 is normal; keep speed changes small. Silence reduction only works on models that support it.

text.description: The text to convert to speech, up to about 300 characters. Use text_to_speech_long for longer text.

voice.description: Soniox voice name or ID. Omit to use the configured default.

language.description: ISO language code of the text, for example en or el. Omit to use the configured default.

speed.description: Speech speed from 0.7 to 1.3, where 1.0 is normal. Keep changes small, because large jumps are very noticeable. Omit to use the configured default.

reduce_silence.description: Shorten pauses between words. Only works on models that support it. Omit to use the configured default.
